plain: Doubtful; not clearly true or reliable

webster.text: Doubtful; wavering or fluctuating in opinion; not settled; not determined; as, the mind is in a dubious state.

more.text: Not clear; not plain; as dubious light.

example.quote: Where words are dubious, they will be explained by the context.
example.cite: Brutus XI, New York Journal, Jan. 31, 1788
